newsitem.title: USA: WPS Resources votes rights plan.
newsitem.headline: WPS Resources votes rights plan.

text.p: WPS Resources Corp said Thursday its board adopted a shareholder rights plan, which includes a dividend of one common share purchase right on each outstanding common share.
The rights, designed to protect the company against abusive takeover tactics, are not being distributed in response to any specific effort to acquire control of the company, WPS said.
The rights will be issued to holders of record at the close of business on December 18, 1996. They will expire December 11, 2006.

WPS, an electric and natural gas company, said the rights will be exercisable only if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of the company's common stock. Each right initially will entitle shareholders to buy one share of the company's common stock at an exercise price of $85 per share.
